sourceDesc.p: Kannada edition of the Chandōmbudhi with modern Kannada paraphrase (PDF chandombudhi-text.pdf, 146 pp.); only the verses of the text are transcribed, all six adhikāras.

projectDesc.p: Only the verses (lines aligned at the left, with the verse number between double bars at the end of the last line) are kept; the word-order prose and the modern paraphrase of the edition are not transcribed. The Kannada was converted to ISO transliteration (ಱ = ṟ, ೞ = ḻ, ಳ = ḷ, ಎ/ಒ = e/o, ಏ/ಓ = ē/ō). The attribute met of a verse is the metre name printed before the verse; verses are grouped by the number of syllables of the pāda, read from the scan of the lines. A word with unclear contains a letter that the transcribers could not read with certainty.
